help.a11yBody: Sangam aims to meet WCAG 2.1 level AA and the Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW).
help.a11yContact: If something is hard to use, tell your administrator; we treat accessibility problems as defects.
help.a11yContrast: Text and controls meet AA contrast in light and dark themes.
help.a11yDiagrams: Diagrams and charts always offer the same figures as a table.
help.a11yKeyboard: Every action can be done with the keyboard; a skip link leads to the main content.
help.a11yLanguage: The whole interface is available in Hindi and English.
help.a11yScreenReader: Pages use headings, landmarks, labelled fields and live announcements.
help.aboutBody: Sangam is an open-source workflow platform built on Operaton. Every feature is free, with no licence key or usage cap.
help.fonts: Fonts: Sakal Bharati by C-DAC GIST (Government of India), with Noto Sans and Noto Sans Devanagari as fallback (all SIL Open Font License 1.1), served from this server.
help.watermark: Diagram and form editors use bpmn.io libraries; their "powered by bpmn.io" watermark stays visible as their licence requires.
